description: The things a person can do to a ticket or a lead from its header, one tab each.
name: Tatva Record Actions

fields.label: Raise a Jira issue
fields.description: Agents and reps raise an issue from a ticket or a lead. The issue links back to the record in Jira. Runs only while the switch Jira::Issues::raise is on.

fields.label: Site
fields.description: Your Jira Cloud address, such as https://yourcompany.atlassian.net.

fields.label: Account email
fields.description: The Jira account every issue is raised as.

fields.label: API token
fields.description: Made under that account's Atlassian security settings.

fields.label: Projects
fields.description: The project keys an issue may be raised in, one per line. The first is preselected.
